title: Since Jesus Came Into My Heart
lyrics: Verse 1:
There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Immanuel's veins
And sinners, plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains
Chorus 1:
Since Jesus came into my heart
Since Jesus came into my heart
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll
Since Jesus came into my heart
Verse 2:
There's a sweet apprehension
A holy reverent fear
That I should be forgiven
And that He would be near
Chorus 2:
Since Jesus came into my heart
Since Jesus came into my heart
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll
Since Jesus came into my heart
Verse 3:
I have heard the song of angels
In sweet harmonious tone
But since Jesus came into my heart
All is different now, alone
Chorus 3:
Since Jesus came into my heart
Since Jesus came into my heart
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll
Since Jesus came into my heart
